#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<int> A(3), B(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) cin >> A[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) cin >> B[i];

    vector<int> A_copy = A;
    vector<int> B_copy = B;

    auto max_wins = [](vector<int> A_list, vector<int> B_list) {
        int total_wins = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            int opponent = (i + 1) % 3;
            int wins = std::min(A_list[i], B_list[opponent]);
            A_list[i] -= wins;
            B_list[opponent] -= wins;
            total_wins += wins;
        }
        return total_wins;
    };

    auto max_losses = [](vector<int> A, vector<int> B) {
        vector<vector<int>> move_combinations = {{0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2}};
        vector<vector<int>> permutations;
        // Generate all permutations of move_combinations
        std::sort(move_combinations.begin(), move_combinations.end());
        do {
            permutations.push_back(move_combinations);
        } while (std::next_permutation(move_combinations.begin(), move_combinations.end()));

        int max_loss = 0;
        for (const auto& perm : permutations) {
            vector<int> A_temp = A;
            vector<int> B_temp = B;
            vector<int> losses(3, 0);
            for (const auto& move : perm) {
                int loss_amount = std::min(A_temp[move[0]], B_temp[move[1]]);
                A_temp[move[0]] -= loss_amount;
                B_temp[move[1]] -= loss_amount;
                losses[move[0]] += loss_amount;
            }
            int total_loss = losses[0] + losses[1] + losses[2];
            if (total_loss > max_loss) {
                max_loss = total_loss;
            }
        }
        return max_loss;
    };

    cout << n - max_losses(A_copy, B_copy) << " " << max_wins(A, B) << "\n";

    return 0;
}
